name: Proposal for a decision
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION requesting the Authority for European Political Parties and European Political Foundations to verify whether Europe of Sovereign Nations Party complies with the conditions laid down in Article 3(1), points (d) and (e), of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2025/2445
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the Authority for European Political Parties and European Political Foundations to check whether a party called Europe of Sovereign Nations Party still meets the conditions for being registered as a European political party. Those conditions concern respect for the values the European Union is founded on. The request follows a letter from the Authority raising doubts about this. Parliament is not deciding the outcome itself; it is asking the Authority to look into it.

- Parliament formally asks the Authority to check the party against the EU values conditions.
- It affects Europe of Sovereign Nations Party and the Authority that oversees EU political parties.
- The Authority now carries out the check; Parliament's President sends it the request.
